description: Pin a message in a channel or thread so it appears in the channel's pinned list. Use it to keep an important message easy to find; use discord_list_pins to see what is pinned and discord_delete_pin to unpin. Returns pinned: true with the channel and message IDs. Bot permissions it may need: View Channel, Pin Messages. Changes Discord data; safe to retry.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel or thread that holds the message

message_id.description: ID of the message to pin

reason.description: Audit log reason sent in the X-Audit-Log-Reason header (up to 512 characters)

name: discord_create_pin

channel_id.description: Discord snowflake ID as a numeric string

message_id.description: Discord snowflake ID as a numeric string
